newsitem.title: ITALY: Berisha assures Italy elections will run smoothly.
newsitem.headline: Berisha assures Italy elections will run smoothly.

text.p: Albanian President Sali Berisha told Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Thursday that the electoral process in Albania would be carried out smoothly and completely, a statement from Prodi's office said.
The statement said Berisha and Socialist Prime Minister Bashkim Fino had both given the assurances during telephone conversations with Prodi earlier on Thursday.

"From the Albanians we were given assurances of the will on the part of the government and of local political forces to carry out the electoral process to the end in the best conditions," the statement said.
"In doing so they assured conditions of legality and democracy would be restored in the country in the most rapid and complete way."

The statement added that during the conversations, Prodi confirmed Italy's intention to "contribute to the best completion of the electoral process in Albania, in view of the second round of voting scheduled for Sunday July 6".
Italy is leading a multinational security force in Albania.

The Socialist Party won the first round of voting in last weekend's general election which was called to restore order to the impoverished Balkan nation after it slid into armed chaos earlier this year.
Earlier on Thursday, the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) warned Berisha and all political parties against putting obstacles in the way of the electoral process.
OSCE said the future of international assistance to Albania depended on Albanian authorities cooperating in the process of democratic reform.
